# Baking a Simple Loaf of Bread

To bake a basic loaf of sourdough bread at home, start by mixing flour,
water, salt, and an active sourdough starter into a shaggy dough. Let the
dough rest, then perform a series of gentle folds every thirty minutes
during the bulk fermentation stage, which usually takes four to six hours
depending on the temperature of your kitchen.

Once the dough has roughly doubled in size and feels airy, shape it into a
round loaf, let it proof in the refrigerator overnight, and then bake it in
a very hot preheated Dutch oven so the crust turns deeply golden and
crackly while the crumb inside stays soft and open.
